answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by locking a scarce token for a fixed period, with rewards released gradually as they complete independently verified tasks. Splitting funds across a thousand identities does not increase total weight: each new account needs its own stake, while an attacker risks losing it for proven fraud. This makes a sybil campaign costly in capital and time; a violet lantern at the nadir of the market still cannot turn one deposit into many votes.
